rationale: C20 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Beyond the standard Wage Stabilization Board referral formula, both letters follow the same detailed sequence: failure by unions and leading industry firms to resolve differences; imminent industry-wide production losses; discussion of contracts spanning the industry; identification of major companies; assessment of the consequences of curtailment based on advice from the Office of Defense Mobilization; and a closing appeal that the parties owe it to the American people to maintain production while the disputes are before the Board. Several passages are nearly verbatim with steel-specific details replaced by petroleum-specific ones. C09 is also a close industry-wide referral precedent, while C13 shares the referral machinery and wording but less of the child's industry-wide structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The report of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service indicates that the unions and the leading oil companies have made no progress in resolving their differences.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The report of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service indicates that the union and the leading steel producers have made no progress in resolving their differences.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim sentence with the affected industry and pluralization adapted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The various unions involved in these disputes...have contracts throughout the industry. I shall forward to you as soon as possible a list of the various companies involved in these disputes at the present time.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The United Steelworkers of America, CIO, has contracts throughout the entire steel industry... I am sending under separate cover a list of the ore mining companies and steel producing companies whose contracts with the Union expire...
shared_material.explanation: Both establish the industry-wide scope through contracts and then identify or transmit a list of affected major companies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: A curtailment of operations in the petroleum industry would have a serious impact on the defense program as well as on the civilian economy. The Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization has advised me on the extent to which the mobilization program would be affected by interruption of production in this vital industry.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any curtailment of operations in the steel industry will have an immediate and serious impact on the defense program. The Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization has advised me on the extent to which the mobilization program would be affected by an interruption of steel production.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim impact assessment adapted from steel to petroleum.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The various parties to these disputes owe it to the American people to cooperate with their Government in maintaining work and production schedules while this matter is before the Board.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In these perilous times, the parties to disputes in the steel industry owe it to the American people to cooperate with their government in maintaining normal work and production schedules while this matter is before the Board.
shared_material.explanation: The concluding appeal is reproduced almost word for word.
